title: Notice regarding Special Court on 27.10.2026 at 11:00 AM
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 26/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 27.10.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 26/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 27.10.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
R.T.Vachhani would sit in Special Division Bench and take
up the notified matters at 11:00 AM.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble Mr.
Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi
would sit in Regular Division Bench and take up the
matters as per Roster.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble Mr.
Justice R.T.Vachhani would sit Single and take up the
matters as per Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
